en-UK.name: Context Compress
en-UK.description: Lets AI characters compress an over-long conversation history into a summary on demand to free context space.
en-UK.description_markdown:
The **Context Compress** plugin gives an AI character a manually triggered tool tag:

```
<compress-context/>
```

When the conversation history approaches the AI source's context limit, the character can emit this tag; the plugin runs a summarisation, folds the history into a single `summary` entry, and reconciles the next round's prompt so the character can keep talking without losing key facts.

It works in ordinary chats and in the character regen loop alike; a single round compresses at most once to avoid duplicate summaries.
en-UK.author: steve02081504

zh-CN.name: 上下文压缩
zh-CN.description: 让 AI 角色按需把过长的对话历史压缩为摘要，腾出上下文空间继续对话
zh-CN.description_markdown:
**上下文压缩**插件为 AI 角色提供一个手动触发的工具标签：

```
<compress-context/>
```

当对话历史接近 AI 源的上下文上限时，角色可以输出该标签；插件会调用摘要生成，把历史收敛为一条 `summary` 条目，并在下一轮生成本轮 prompt，使角色在不丢失关键信息的前提下继续对话。

该工具在普通聊天与角色 regen 循环中均可使用；同一轮生成最多压缩一次，避免重复摘要。
zh-CN.author: steve02081504
